text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by a fast-food 
restaurant, I bumped into Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Are you getting something to eat, Trainer? 
Taiki invited me along~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, she's back. Welcome back, Taiki-sa~n.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting~☆ Oh, Doto's 
Trainer came along too, I see!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Perfect timing, yes! Let's eat together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Taiki Shuttle piled up a 
mountain of hamburgers on the table.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa! Wh-What on earth is with this 
amount...?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is a thank-you for always helping me 
out, YES! Thanks for lending me lots of 
pens!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A gift full of gratitude... I call it the 
"Hamburger Tower," please, enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A present for me...!? Are you sure!? I-I'm 
so happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! But please don't push yourself, 
feel free to take whatever you can't 
finish to go, okay!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...No, I will finish it. I'll finish it 
and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to Taiki-san's 
feelings~!!
choice_data_list: Keep it to an amount you can enjoy eating!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auugh... Y-Yes, you're right. It's a 
wonderful gift, so I'll savor every bit of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Eating delicious food makes 
everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Thank you for the food! ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto thoroughly enjoyed her 
hamburger without overeating!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes! T-Time to eat!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*nibble*... *gulp, chew chew*! I-It's so 
yummy...! *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Amazing! That's some wild eating, 
isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto devoured every last hamburger, 
eating as if she'd drop right there on the 
spot!
